ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green leafy pieces with darker green edges, limp and glossy with a creamy dressing coating, torn strips about 3-5 cm long, spread across the upper-left and center of a white square plate covering roughly 35% of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Creamy pale yellow dressing or sauce coating the leafy pieces, glossy and semi-opaque, clinging to leaf surfaces and pooling slightly where leaves overlap | 15
ITEM 3 | Rectangular piece of flatbread-style crust, about 7 x 5 cm and 1.5 cm thick, golden-brown with dark charred spots along the bottom-left edge, topped with melted pale cheese and red tomato sauce, slightly glossy, sitting at the lower-center of the plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Small pale yellow-green leaf fragments, one or two pieces about 3 cm long, limp and creamy, scattered near the lower-left edge of the plate beside the crust | 8
